$comment: Maps the application's semantic roles (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground…) and legacy scale names onto tokens in tokens.json. This file holds NO values: change a value in tokens.json, change a mapping here only when a role should mean a different token. Consumed by scripts/build-tokens.mjs and design-system/tailwind-preset.ts.

fonts.$comment: Families that next/font self-hosts (src/lib/fonts.ts). The generator wraps them as var(--font-x, "Name") so the real hashed family is used when loaded and the plain name otherwise.

textAliases.$comment: Legacy Tailwind text-* names → DS type styles. New code should use the DS names (text-display-l, text-body, text-label…).

radiusAliases.$comment: Legacy rounded-* names → DS radius tokens (without the radius- prefix).

shadowAliases.$comment: DS elevation is flat by default: only floating chrome (shadow-float) and sheets (shadow-sheet) cast a shadow. Legacy names resolve accordingly.

radiusNames.$comment: Tailwind already owns rounded-s / rounded-l (start / left side corners), so the DS radii s, m, l are exposed as rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-lg. xs and pill keep their names.
